entries.mem0ai/mem0: This universal memory layer provides multi-level storage for user, session, and agent states using temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval. It is available as an Apache-2.0 self-hosted server, an OSS SDK, or a managed cloud service.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: Organizing context as a virtual filesystem via viking:// URIs, this database utilizes a three-tier loading system to achieve a 91% reduction in token consumption. It features observable retrieval trajectories for debugging and is licensed under AGPL-3.0.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: This engine utilizes a custom vector graph and byte-level deduplication to sustain sub-300ms recall at scales exceeding 100B tokens per month. It automates fact extraction and user profiling through hybrid search and connectors for platforms like Google Drive and GitHub.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This agent brain features a self-wiring knowledge graph with typed edges to provide synthesized answers, citations, and gap analysis. It is designed for multi-user team environments through the use of scoped access controls.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight implements long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows to create agent memory that learns over time. It supports over 25 LLM providers and is deployable via Docker, Kubernetes, or Python and Node.js clients.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: This library provides a FastAPI server and SDKs for building stateful agents with hybrid search and prompt-ready context injection. It serves as the upstream foundation for self-hosted Hermes memory wrappers.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: Operating under the Elastic License 2.0, this tool manages context trees using git-like versioning for commits, branches, and merges. It features a 5-tier retrieval system that achieves sub-100ms speeds across 20 supported LLM providers.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: This zero-dependency system provides sub-millisecond memory operations using a single SQLite database and one Python dependency. It supports the Model Context Protocol (MCP) for integration with tools like Cursor, Claude Code, and Windsurf.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This seven-layer system utilizes a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize injected context over other data. It runs on local infrastructure including Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite to manage structured facts and auto-curated wikis.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: This recursive harness uses outcome-gated promotion for context bundles and playbooks to assist agents with complex tasks. It integrates with MCP clients and OpenAI-compatible endpoints via Python and TypeScript implementations.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This plugin uses a SQLite-backed message store and a hierarchical DAG to ensure lossless context management. It builds depth-aware summary nodes and provides tools for agents to search and expand compacted material.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This backend enables private cross-session persistence for Hermes Agents through a self-hosted implementation of Honcho. It includes automated setup scripts for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis, supporting any OpenAI-compatible provider.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signet-AI provides a local-first identity and memory layer that ensures portable state across Hermes Agent and other MCP clients. It achieves 97.6% LongMemEval accuracy and supports data imports from Obsidian, Discord, and GitHub.
entries.plur-ai/plur: This shared memory layer utilizes an open engram YAML format to store data locally in a human-readable way. It integrates with Hermes-compatible tools like Claude Code and OpenClaw using hybrid retrieval powered by BM25 and local embedders.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device context engine that operates entirely locally without the need for API keys or cloud dependencies. It utilizes hybrid retrieval, combining BM25 and vector search, to serve agents via MCP and Claude Code hooks.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: ContextPilot optimizes long-context LLM inference for Hermes Agent by using block reordering and deduplication to enable prefix reuse. These optimizations reduce prefill latency by 1.5–3× and can save up to 36% of tokens.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl-Memory is a file-based long-term memory system that avoids vector databases and embeddings in favor of SQLite with FTS5 search. It features a five-package plugin family, including a dedicated Hermes adapter and a LangGraph BaseStore.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin provides explainable retrieval by tagging every recalled memory with a reason for its selection. It features automated maintenance through a gap-to-task loop and includes built-in tracking for contradictions and recency.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack acts as a memory kernel for Hermes, consolidating Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single management layer. It utilizes SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to deliver purpose-built evidence packets to the agent for every query.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: Flowstate-qmd introduces anticipatory memory by prefetching context based on agent session logs. It is an MCP-native server that uses SQLite-vec and GGUF models for local-first storage and retrieval.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: Agentcairn enables cross-project memory by using a user's Obsidian vault as the primary source of truth. It stores memory as inspectable Markdown files and uses DuckDB as a replaceable retrieval cache for coding agents.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: Keep provides reflective memory through semantic search, BM25 full-text ranking, and graph traversal. It automates indexing for codebases and multimedia while using edge tags to create bidirectional relationships between notes.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: Perseus resolves live workspace state into verified facts to ensure agents only load necessary context. This local-first architecture can reduce prompt tokens by 94% and exposes context via MCP-native stdio or SSE servers.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This utility reduces Hermes Agent tool-schema overhead by using local BM25 ranking to select relevant keywords. It includes a dashboard to track token savings and is compatible with Hermes Agent v0.14.0.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes a single .lbdb embedded graph database file to manage agent memory. It features importance-weighted recall to surface high-priority entries and supports BM25 keyword search alongside named graph relationships.
entries.conorbronsdon/claude-context-os: This project provides a shared lifecycle kernel for Hermes and other agents, storing durable context and decision logs in plain Markdown. It includes a migration workflow to convert chat archives into reviewable files and uses a Git-backed layer for workflow management.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: A pull-model episodic memory plugin that supports real, immediate event deletion to prevent persistent summaries from affecting future recall. It features an on-demand summarizer and maintains a trace.jsonl audit log for all memory and prefetch operations.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider enables durable cross-session memory through pre-turn context injection and session-end snapshots. It relies on a local SQLite reliability layer and a write outbox to facilitate searching, remembering, and updating agent state.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server allows Hermes agents to handle payments using USDC and stablecoins across ten chain families, including EVM and Solana. It enables APIs to charge for services and agents to pay for them with a few lines of code.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin indexes local skills, scripts, and MCP server configurations to facilitate capability routing. It provides tools for graph neighbor traversal and supports both manual and opt-in implicit feedback to optimize routing results.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: Integrating Exabase M-1, this plugin provides self-organizing long-term memory for Hermes agents. It includes tools for manual memory storage and supports configurable query expansion and result reranking to improve retrieval accuracy.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This AI-native memory solution offers AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports HNSW ANN, sparse, and FM-index retrieval. It can be executed via native Rust FFI or as an HTTP daemon and includes MinHash deduplication.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private local code memory for repositories, requiring a local SourceVault server for indexing and vector storage. It adds deterministic slash commands for search and sync, alongside LLM-callable tools for grounded Q&A.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This project features 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal using a hybrid search of BM25, vector, and graph methods. It also performs automatic context checkpointing during message compression.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: A file-based curation loop that uses a git-backed directory to manage versioned, diffable markdown memory without a database. It includes 'rot' and 'lint' curators to identify stale or conflicting data and provides slash commands for capture and recall.

entries.xintaofei/codeg: Available as a desktop or self-hosted app, this collaborative workspace aggregates 15 built-in agents and supports task delegation via @ mentions. It allows users to run background tasks on separate branches for manual review and merging.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: Designed as a native Mac workspace, this tool provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts with an embedded terminal for shell access. It includes native views for managing Kanban boards, cron jobs, and session data.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, this Windows-first application includes the Hermes-CN-Core kernel for local agent execution. The interface supports LaTeX and Mermaid rendering while providing dedicated UI components for MCP tools and memory management.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension links active browser context to local, cloud, or remote Hermes Agent runtimes. It includes an MV3 controller for approved tab actions and a site-aware drafting assistant compatible with 31 writing environments.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: This native SwiftUI application for iOS 18+ allows users to drive a self-hosted Hermes Agent from an iPhone by pairing with a hermes-webui server. It enables mobile management of agent tasks and skills while providing read-only access to memory and analytics.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: Wesight offers a desktop workspace with one-click setup for Hermes Agent and other engines, featuring custom LLM model routing. It includes a runtime dashboard for tracking latency and token usage, alongside a live workspace for monitoring code writes and diffs.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard provides a comprehensive control plane for the Hermes stack, featuring a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking kanban pipelines. It distinguishes itself with an MCP server lifecycle manager and real-time tool call visualization within the chat interface.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS cockpit designed to aggregate searchable transcripts and image previews from 14 different agent sources. It focuses on local privacy and resource management by tracking per-session quota burn for Codex and Claude models without telemetry.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS workspace facilitates one-click automated Hermes Agent installations on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It is unique for its integrated WebRTC voice mode which utilizes OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and React 19, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web-based interface. It features a dedicated approval inbox for managing agent requests that have side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: This project offers an alternative TUI and dashboard built with OpenTUI for managing Hermes sessions and toolsets. It includes a specialized kanban board for agentic work and supports the management of profiles, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: A mobile-first React SPA designed for Telegram Mini App v2.0 that supports background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances. It ensures secure access through dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication while providing a terminal chat with streaming responses.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This Windows desktop GUI requires no installation, Docker, or admin rights, making the Hermes Agent fully portable. It includes a dynamic tool maker for API and Python handlers and supports connections to both cloud and local AI models.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: A glassmorphic web interface that provides real-time log streaming and a task tracking dashboard for the self-hosted assistant. It serves as a management hub for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers alongside an integrated file browser.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: This dashboard focuses on process monitoring, allowing users to track session activity and costs in real time. It provides read-only access to environment variables and full inspection capabilities for conversation histories and skill source code.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A chat-first workspace that utilizes isolated profiles for managing separate sessions, memory, and API keys. It features an integrated marketplace for discovering skills and MCP servers, complemented by tool approval cards and SSE streaming.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This native desktop client coordinates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents through a PM orchestrator. It features a visual Skill Store with over 50 one-click installations and supports real-time model switching during streaming chat.
